ticker_selection_note: Ticker set to RMSP.XC (Cboe Europe, CXE, EUR) for cross-arm parity, decided 2026-08-13 before any event was scored. History of the decision: (1) initial choice was RMS.PA (Euronext Paris, PAR, EUR) on primary-listing grounds — Paris is the authoritative home exchange for a French issuer, Cboe Europe is a secondary venue with thinner data; (2) cross-arm price verification against Master_Data_CORRECTED_2026-08-13.xlsx showed that Human_Data_Entry columns M-P match RMSP.XC at 0.00% on all 4 events (8 price values: prior close and next open) and diverge from RMS.PA by 0.55-3.11% (largest: Q1 opening price, RMS.PA 2306.00 vs human-arm 2236.50 = 3.11%); (3) a 3.11% divergence against a ±2% grading band is large enough to move an event across the graded/ungraded boundary — an event could be graded in one arm and not the other on identical underlying news; (4) cross-arm parity was judged to outweigh venue quality, and the manifest was reverted from RMS.PA to RMSP.XC. The corrected workbook was not re-opened. Limitation: Hermes prices in both arms now come from a secondary venue (Cboe Europe) rather than the Paris primary listing; this is a data-quality caveat on all four Hermes events. Timing classification is unaffected (both venues open 09:00 CET).
filename_note: Files on disk use the RMSP.XC_ prefix (the ticker as originally named before document_id was changed from RMSP.XC_FQ* to RMS_FQ*). Manifest source_pdf paths reference the actual on-disk filenames. FQ3 2025 has a transcript on disk; it was omitted from the original manifest because Hermes Q3 is typically a revenue-only update, but a call transcript was gathered and is included here.
